2021-009                            ISSUER: Gus Sirakis, P.E.
                                               First Deputy Commissioner

                                  PURPOSE: This bulletin rescinds one guidance document and four
 TECHNICAL                                    Buildings Bulletins that are no longer applicable.

ISSUANCE DATE                   SUBJECT(S): RESCINDED COVID-19 Buildings Bulletins and Guidance
  July 8, 2021


     RESCINDS: DOB’s Phase 1 Reopening Guidance and Buildings Bulletins
     2020-006, 2020-010, 2020-015; 2021-008


 The Department of Buildings rescinds the following Buildings Bulletins and Guidance:
 •   BB 2020-006 (issued on April 22, 2020) – updated guidance to owners and contractors regarding how
     to secure their construction and demolition sites when operations are suspended due to the ongoing
     COVID-19 public health emergency;
 •   DOB’s Phase 1 Reopening Guidance (issued on June 5, 2020);
 •   BB 2020-010 (issued on June 7, 2020) – updated guidance to owners and contractors regarding the
     reopening of sites whose operations were suspended due to the ongoing COVID-19 public health
     emergency;
 •   BB 2020-015 (issued on July 24, 2020) – describes the application process for qualifying educational
     institutions to obtain approval for temporary student dormitory use in hotels;
 •   BB 2021-008 (issued on May 28, 2021) – describes when a DOB permit application is not required and
     how to determine the number of occupants for the reopening of indoor food services and dining in
     restaurants and establishments in New York City.

 Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the issuance date of this Bulletin. The
 documents will appear on the Department website with the watermark RESCINDED. Because the process
 is ongoing, documents not specifically listed in this Bulletin may still be addressed in future bulletins.

 Additionally, watermarked directives, Executive Orders, letters, and memoranda may be accessed online at
 http://www.nyc.gov/html/dob/html/codes_and_reference_materials/buildings_bulletin.shtml.




 MELANIE E. LA ROCCA, Commissioner                                                      nyc.gov/buildings
